subject.title: normalizeGitHubActor: not idempotent — strips only one trailing [bot]

question: Should repeated trailing `[bot]` suffixes be normalized for requester grouping while mutation authorization continues to reject the raw repeated-suffix identity?
rationale: The requested helper invariant is narrow, but actor normalization is adjacent to the authorization boundary and the existing human review explicitly reserved this behavior for deliberate assessment.

options.title: Accept grouped normalization with raw authorization
options.body: Merge the linked PR after confirming tests prove repeated-suffix identities stay unauthorized by the exact raw-actor comparator.

options.title: Keep one-pass normalization
options.body: Reject the idempotence change if maintainers want requester grouping to preserve malformed repeated bot suffixes.

recommendation.title: Accept grouped normalization with raw authorization
recommendation.body: Merge the linked PR after confirming tests prove repeated-suffix identities stay unauthorized by the exact raw-actor comparator.
